title: Very Disappointed! Leaks at the bottom.
text: Very Disappointed! Leaks at the bottom.. I’ve wanted one of these personal blenders for a while. Saw this one, good price, bought it. It’s much smaller than the other brands you usually see. Not very powerful either. Mine leaks from the bottom, no matter how I try to adjust the gasket!

product_metadata.title: Portable Blender, Mini Juicer Cup Personal Size Blender Shakes and Smoothies USB Rechargeable (Green)
features: Food-Grade Material: The juicer smoothie blender compact and portable design is made from BPA free food-safe materials. It fits in most standard size cup holders. The built-in strainer can filter out excess pulp.

Built-in Rechargeable Batteries: Portable blender USB rechargeable comes equipped with a built-in 2600mAh rechargeable battery that can be recharged in a variety of ways, like charging by power bank, AC Adapter, and computer, and charging time is 3-5 hours; Portable Blenders can blend 15-20 cups of juice after every Recharge.（warning：When using it for the first time, please charge the juicer fully before using it）

Upgraded 3D Powerful 4 Blades: This portable smoothie blender has 4 pCS 3D sawtooth blades is made of SUS304 stainless steel having 22,000 revolutions per minute which can effortlessly make fruits, vegetables, and liquidized anything including small ice cubes in no time into a smoothie and do not leave chunks of fruit and ice and no noisy like traditional blenders.

Easy Cleaning and Blending: Never having to clean the portable smoothie blender again. Just add water and an optional drop of soap, and run your blender until it is clean. Blending your favorite smoothies, shakes, margaritas, or baby food with a single button.（warning：Double-click the button to turn on, and then click to turn off）

Multi-Functional & Portability: Travel Blender for Shakes & Smoothies great for making nutritious single-portion smoothies, Salad dressings, juice blends, mix fruits and vegetables, coffee, milk powder, protein shake, baby supplementary food; Not only for mixing kinds of fruit and vegetables, but also can be used as a bottle; It is very portable for kitchen, office, traveling, camping, outdoor, etc.
